Class ConsoleRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.codewithmagret.ui.ConsoleRenderer
public class ConsoleRenderer extends Object
This class is responsible for rendering the results of the queries to the console. It is used by the ReportService after fetching the data from the database. Each method corresponds to a specific report and takes a list of rows as input. The methods should handle null or empty lists gracefully and print appropriate messages. The output should be formatted in a clear and readable way, using indentation and bullet points where necessary.

  • Method Details

    • printCoursesByCategory

      public void printCoursesByCategory(List<CoursesByCategory> rows)
      This method prints the courses grouped by category to the console. It takes a list of CoursesByCategory objects as input and formats the output in a readable way. If the list is null or empty, it prints a message indicating that there is no data. For each category, it prints the category name and the number of courses in that category. If there are no courses in a category, it indicates that as well. For each course, it prints the course code and title.
      Parameters:
      rows - the list of CoursesByCategory objects to print

    • printCoursesByStudent

      public void printCoursesByStudent(List<CoursesByStudent> rows)
      This method prints the courses taken by each student to the console. It takes a list of CoursesByStudent objects as input and formats the output in a readable way. If the list is null or empty, it prints a message indicating that there is no data. For each student, it prints the full name and the number of courses taken by that student. If there are no courses taken by a student, it indicates that as well. For each course, it prints the course code and title.
      Parameters:
      rows - the list of CoursesByStudent objects to print

    • printInstructorsByCourse

      public void printInstructorsByCourse(List<InstructorByCourse> rows)
      This method prints the instructors for each course to the console. It takes a list of InstructorByCourse objects as input and formats the output in a readable way. If the list is null or empty, it prints a message indicating that there is no data. For each course, it prints the course code, title, instructor's full name, and email (if available). If any of these fields are null, it uses a placeholder "-" to indicate missing data.
      Parameters:
      rows - the list of InstructorByCourse objects to print

    • printInstructorsByStudent

      public void printInstructorsByStudent(List<InstructorsByStudent> rows)
      This method prints the instructors associated with each student to the console. It takes a list of InstructorsByStudent objects as input and formats the output in a readable way. If the list is null or empty, it prints a message indicating that there is no data. For each student, it prints the full name and the number of instructors associated with that student. If there are no instructors associated with a student, it indicates that as well. For each instructor, it prints the instructor's full name and email (if available). If any of these fields are null, it uses a placeholder "-" to indicate missing data.
      Parameters:
      rows - the list of InstructorsByStudent objects to print
